cc:Work.dc:title: Paired source-retention effects
cc:Work.dc:description: R81 AUTO_DETAIL minus U25/ETA/Flow/RFEDIT; source-retention metrics. Equal-source means, 20000 percentile source-bootstrap resamples, 95% CI; NumPy default_rng seed 81030 (analysis-wide sequential stream). NCC n=24 sources/48 cases; preservation MAE n=19/38. Source data: tables/r81_paired_contrasts.csv.
